controls.rule: Every governed project has team/project ID, product purpose, repository, branch, root, domains, environment model, owner, lifecycle state, and rollback.
Every preview or production claim binds exact Git SHA to exact Vercel project and deployment.
Each project sharing a repository has explicit root and trigger controls; unrelated changes must not fan out uncontrolled deployments.
Development, Preview, and Production variable inventories are distinct and values are never recorded in evidence.
Privileged tokens, service-role keys, database credentials, and provider secrets remain server-side in approved secret stores.
Preview acceptance covers project/root/SHA, protected access, route/API checks, applicable device/UI checks, auth/data/provider path, console/runtime errors, and critical user journey.
Protection is not disabled merely to simplify agent access.
Functions validate input, authenticate/authorize, bound timeouts/retries, keep secrets server-side, return honest failure states, and emit trace/evidence IDs.
Cloud Functions do not assume localhost access to DCS workstations; local inference uses an authorized durable exchange/worker path.
Domain changes identify exact domain, owner, project/deployment target, DNS/certificate/canonical behavior, legacy aliases, and rollback.
BUILT, PREVIEW_READY, VALIDATED, APPROVED, PROMOTED, OBSERVED, RECONCILED, and COMPLETE are distinct states.
Production promotion requires exact validated deployment, checks, environment review, dependencies, domain/customer-path proof, rollback, and DCS approval or verified delegation.
Rollback records target deployment, reason, scope, user impact, data compatibility, post-rollback verification, and unresolved external side effects.
Quota exhaustion stops retry storms; plan upgrades do not substitute for correcting duplicate projects, bad roots, or uncontrolled triggers.
READY/build state alone is insufficient; runtime logs and user-visible behavior are required when relevant.
GitHub source, Vercel deployment/runtime, data-side effects, and Tribunal decisions reconcile before COMPLETE.
Inspection authority does not imply deploy, promote, domain, billing, protection, secret, or cross-system mutation authority.
Vercel governance promotion does not waive the independent 2026-09-15 Supabase audit HOLD or authorize database remediation.
